request.prompt: ONE FINAL DEATH: HEAVY ARMORED KNIGHT COLLAPSE. Animate this EXACT Ash Warden, fixed front South top-down camera. First a fatal blow jerks BOTH armored shoulders and chest backward, knees buckle. He heavily sinks onto BOTH KNEES, helmet drops and chest pitches forward under enormous armor weight. BOTH hands lose grip; the SAME broad greatsword slips from his gauntlets to his LEFT and drops flat onto the ground, blade stays WHOLE and visible beside him. Then his heavy chest and helmet COLLAPSE FORWARD onto the ground, both shoulder plates tilt down and spread with the arms, bent legs remain behind, branches and torn tabard settle with inertia. Finish as a LARGE LOW HORIZONTAL PRONE ARMORED CORPSE, no recovery or standing up. This is actual articulated knees, hips, elbows, neck and torso movement: NOT a rotating rigid sprite, NOT shrinking, NOT just fading or changing color, NOT idle. Retain exact charcoal chunky armor, wide pauldrons, narrow visor, orange cracks, dry branches, roots, ash cloth and massive sword. No redesign, no plain knight. Full death progression from standing to knees to prone. Single consistent character and sword, never duplicate or vanish. Entire figure, corpse, fallen weapon and branches stay inside original canvas. No camera motion, no zoom, no dust, particles, fire, smoke, flash, crater, scenery or other VFX in these character frames. Transparent background.
